programme.title: Schicksalstage Österreichs
programme.sub-title: 2015: The big escape / 2015: Die groSSe Flucht
programme.desc: In the new episode of "Austria's" Fate Days ", ORF III is devoted to one of the most drastic moments of young history. The documentation of Judith Doppler reconstructs the dramatic days in early September 2015 when tens of thousands of escape lodges came to Austria - and political, moral and logistical systems reached their limits. A few days earlier, the disadvantage of Parndorf had shown with more than 70 dead that the migration movement and its supporting modes had arrived in the heart of Europe. At the center of the documentation are the crisis management of Federal Chancellor Werner Faymann and the diplomatic negotiations with Viktor Orban, Angela Merkel and EU Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker. Today's Lower Easter General Governor Johanna Mikl-Leitner remembers the tensions inside the government. Christian Kern, Sebastian Kurz and Michael Haupl describe their view of the political and human challenges of these weeks. Journalist Rainer Nowak and author Susanne Scholl classify the events in the larger European context. The film also shows the other side of this state of emergency: the spontaneous willingness to help. At the Vienna Central Station, "Train of Hope" is created with an initiative that quickly becomes a symbol. Take over thousands of volunteers that state structures cannot cope with. In interviews with representatives of various aid organizations, as well as talking with refugees, the documentation also illuminates the human aspects of these dramatic weeks. From October 2015, the focus is relocated to playing field in Styria. Pictures of chaotic scenes are the public perception - and cause the mood in the country. The discussion about a fence along Austria's borders leads to the word of the year "structural measure", but also illustrates how torn the country is now in the question of migration policy. Spaded with the striking of Paris in November 2015, the debate changed sustainably. What was decided within a few weeks at the time has been re -effect on today - and a decade also asks the question of how Europe wants to deal with flight, security and integration. / In der neuen Folge von "Schicksalstage Österreichs" widmet sich ORF III einem der einschneidendsten Momente der jungeren Geschichte. Die Dokumentation von Judith Doppler rekonstruiert die dramatischen Tage Anfang September 2015, als zehntausende Fluchtlinge uber Ungarn nach Österreich gelangten - und politische, moralische wie logistische Systeme an ihre Grenzen stieSSen.Schon wenige Tage zuvor hatte das Ungluck von Parndorf mit mehr als 70 Toten gezeigt, dass die Migrationsbewegung und ihre Tragodien im Herzen Europas angekommen waren. Im Zentrum der Dokumentation stehen das Krisenmanagement von Bundeskanzler Werner Faymann und die diplomatischen Verhandlungen mit Viktor Orban, Angela Merkel und EU-Kommissionsprasident Jean-Claude Juncker.Wahrend die Dublin-Regelung de facto auSSer Kraft gesetzt wird, ringt Europa um eine gemeinsame Linie - unter dem Druck von Bildern, die um die Welt gehen. Die heutige niederosterreichische Landeshauptfrau Johanna Mikl-Leitner erinnert sich an die Spannungen im Inneren der Regierung. Christian Kern, Sebastian Kurz und Michael Haupl schildern ihre Sicht auf die politischen und menschlichen Herausforderungen dieser Wochen. Journalist Rainer Nowak und Autorin Susanne Scholl ordnen die Ereignisse im groSSeren europaischen Kontext ein.Der Film zeigt aber auch die andere Seite dieses Ausnahmezustands: die spontane Hilfsbereitschaft. Am Wiener Hauptbahnhof entsteht mit "Train of Hope" eine Initiative, die rasch zum Symbol wird. Tausende Freiwillige ubernehmen, was staatliche Strukturen nicht bewaltigen konnen. In Interviews mit Vertreterinnen und Vertretern verschiedener Hilfsorganisationen, sowie Gesprachen mit gefluchteten Personen, beleuchtet die Dokumentation auch die menschlichen Aspekte dieser dramatischen Wochen.Ab Oktober 2015 verlagert sich der Brennpunkt nach Spielfeld in der Steiermark. Bilder von chaotischen Szenen pragen die offentliche Wahrnehmung - und verandern die Stimmung im Land. Die Diskussion uber einen Zaun entlang Österreichs Grenzen fuhrt zum Unwort des Jahres "Bauliche MaSSnahme", verdeutlicht aber auch, wie zerrissen das Land mittlerweile in der Frage der Migrationspolitik ist. Spatestens mit den Anschlagen von Paris im November 2015 verandert sich die Debatte dann nachhaltig.Was damals innerhalb weniger Wochen entschieden wurde, wirkt bis heute nach - und stellt auch ein Jahrzehnt spater noch die Frage, wie Europa mit Flucht, Sicherheit und Integration umgehen will.

programme.title: The Austrians and their roots - flight and asylum after 1945 / Die Österreicher und ihre Wurzeln - Flucht und Asyl nach 1945
programme.desc: The second half of the 20th century gives Austria and its population of blessed peace and growing prosperity - but there are miserably in other countries, negative pressure and war. Hundreds of thousands of Hungary and Czechoslovaks flee to Austria in front of the Soviet army and over the decades, escape lodges come from various corners in the world to settle in Austria. The last part of ORF III production "The Austrians and their roots" shows how Austria reacts to the challenges of various flight movements - and how different the Austrians experience the resulting changes in society. / Die zweite Halfte des 20. Jahrhunderts beschert Österreich und seiner Bevolkerung seligen Frieden und wachsenden Wohlstand - in anderen Landern herrschen aber Elend, Unterdruckung und Krieg. So fliehen hunderttausende Ungarn und Tschechoslowaken vor der sowjetischen Armee nach Österreich und im Laufe der Jahrzehnte kommen Fluchtlinge aus verschiedensten Ecken der Welt, um sich in Österreich niederzulassen. Der letzte Teil der ORF III-Produktion "Die Österreicher und ihre Wurzeln" zeigt, wie Österreich auf die Herausforderungen diverser Fluchtbewegungen reagiert - und wie unterschiedlich die Österreicherinnen und Österreicher die daraus folgenden Veranderungen in der Gesellschaft erleben.

programme.title: The Austrians and their roots - Kebap, Bosna, paprika / Die Österreicher und ihre Wurzeln - Kebap, Bosna, Paprika
programme.desc: After the deprivation -rich post -war period, Austria experienced a great economic upswing from the 1950s. The industry is booming and the need for work can hardly be covered - for this reason, Austria decides to actively recruit workers. From the 1960s, hundreds of thousands of migrants move to Austria in order to subordinate the Esterreich economy with their workforce. The so -called "guest workers" contribute significantly to the wealth of prosperity of this time - and drove to a new, more diverse Esterreichian identity, which is also reflected in culinary delights. Today Kebap and Bosna remained the most popular "delicacies" that can be bought on every street corner. The ORF-III series "The Austrians and their roots" embarks on the traces of the colorful history of origin of the Austrians. / Nach der entbehrungsreichen Nachkriegszeit erfahrt Österreich ab den 1950ern einen groSSen wirtschaftlichen Aufschwung. Die Industrie boomt und der Arbeitskraftebedarf kann kaum gedeckt werden - aus diesem Grund beschlieSSt Österreich, aktiv Arbeiter anzuwerben. Durch die Anwerbeabkommen ziehen ab den 1960ern hunderttausende Migranten nach Österreich, um mit ihrer Arbeitskraft die osterreichische Wirtschaft zu unterstutzen. Die sogenannten "Gastarbeiter" tragen erheblich zum Wohlstandsgewinn dieser Zeit bei - und fuhren zu einer neuen, vielfaltigeren osterreichischen Identitat, die sich auch kulinarisch niederschlagt. Heute gehoren Kebap und Bosna zu den beliebtesten "Schmankerln", die man an jeder StraSSenecke kaufen kann. Die ORF-III-Reihe "Die Österreicher und ihre Wurzeln" begibt sich auf die Spuren der bunten Herkunftsgeschichte der Österreicherinnen und Österreicher.

programme.desc: The ORF III documentary series "The Austrians and their roots" illuminates the diverse origin of the Austrians. Die Schrecken des Zweiten Weltkriegs fuhren in den 1940er Jahren zu riesigen Migrationsbewegungen - in ganz Europa suchen ehemalige Zwangsarbeiter, KZ-Überlebende oder Vertriebene nach einer neuen Heimat.Fast die gesamte deutschsprachige Minderheit in der damaligen Tschechoslowakei, die Sudetendeutschen, wird teils brutalst vertrieben - hunderttausende davon finden Aufnahme in Österreich.Teil zwei des Dokuvierteilers von Judith Doppler und Kurt Mayer erzahlt von den turbulenten Nachkriegsjahren und den Schicksalen der Fluchtenden und Vertriebenen.

Ob pomanjkanju uciteljic in uciteljev v ljudskih šolah južne Koroške se dvojezicni šolski sistem sooca z novimi izzivi, pri cemer se postavlja vprašanje o dvojezicni usposobljenosti preusmerjencev.Že 50. let Kršcanska kulturna zveza za otroške in mladinske gledališke skupine nudi možnost enotedenskih intenzivnih vaj. Tokrat se je delavnice v Ankaranu udeležilo 12 skupin.Moderation: Magda KropiunigRedaktion: Niko KupperGesamtleitung: Marijan Velik

In the end, does the future win? / Ob AfD, Trump oder Brexit: Mit der Sehnsucht nach der "guten alten Zeit" werden Wahlen gewonnen. Wie beeinflusst dieser Mythos unsere Kultur? Bestimmt Nostalgie unser Zukunftsdenken?In einer Welt im Krisenmodus erleben konservative Werte und traditionelle Geschlechterrollen ein Comeback. Je schneller der technische Fortschritt unsere Gesellschaft verandert, um so groSSer scheint das Verlangen nach dem vermeintlich einfachen Leben.Warum boomt das Versprechen einer besseren Vergangenheit?Mehr Nostalgie war nie: Von "Das Kanu des Manitu" bis Oasis: Erfolg hat, was unsere Erinnerungen an ein scheinbar intaktes Gestern stimuliert. Die Vergangenheit, sagt Bestsellerautor und Neurowissenschaftler Henning Beck, scheint beherrschbar, die Zukunft ist dagegen ungewiss. Und deshalb zwangen sich Politiker der groSSen Parteien ins Trachtenjankerl oder setzt sich der Thuringer AfD-Chef Bjorn Hocke auf eine Simson aus DDR-Produktion: Statt Antworten auf die Krisen der Gegenwart zu geben, nutzen politische Akteure die Sehnsucht nach der Vergangenheit - mit weitreichenden Folgen fur Gesellschaft und Demokratie.Jo Schuck trifft Autorin Hannah Luhmann, deren Roman "Heimat" die Sehnsucht nach klaren Geschlechterrollen und einem traditionellen Familienbild beleuchtet. Protagonistin Jana lernt auf dem Land die Tradwife Karolin kennen - Hausfrau, funffache Mutter und neurechte Influencerin. Ihr Leben ist mehr als bloSSe Idylle - es ist ein politisches Statement und zugleich die zeitgemaSSe Verfuhrung zuruck in ultratraditionelle Abhangigkeiten.Sind wir der Nostalgie ausgeliefert?Rein faktisch scheint die Sache klar: Nie war das Leben der Menschheit besser als heute. Aber eben auch herausfordernder, schneller und unsicherer. War fruher vielleicht doch vieles besser? Jo Schuck macht den Selbstversuch und verbringt einen Tag im Fruhmittelalter: Im badischen MeSSkich entsteht eine mittelalterliche Klosterstadt - ganz ohne moderne Technik. Die Ruckbesinnung aufs Ursprungliche fasziniert nicht nur auf dem Campus Galli: Ist ein Leben im Einklang mit der Natur der Ausweg aus den Überforderungen der Gegenwart?Aussteigen aus der Gesellschaft - zwischen Romantik und Realitat.Marc Freukes hat schon vor uber zehn Jahren den groSSen Schritt gewagt. Er kehrte der burgerlichen Welt den Rucken und ist in den Wald gezogen. Seitdem unterrichtet der ehemalige Golfprofi aussteigewillige GroSSstadter in Survival-Skills. Bei naherer Betrachtung aber scheint auch das einfache Leben seine Tucken zu haben. Davon erzahlt "Ausgsting", der neue Kino-Film der Wittmann-Bruder. Wolfgang "Gangerl" Clemens schippert seit uber 40 Jahren uber die sieben Weltmeere. Ein bayerisches Original, das auf die harte Tour lernen musste, dass die Freiheit ihren Preis hat.In der Berliner Westernstadt "Old Texas Town" spricht Jo Schuck mit Historiker Tobias Becker uber die Frage: Warum sehnen wir uns nach einer Vergangenheit, die es so nie gab - und wie gefahrlich ist diese kollektive Illusion?Zumindest fur den Western-Stadt-Verein ist die Gefahr greifbar. Im 75. Vereinsjubilaum haben die Spandauer Cowboys die Kundigung erhalten. Die Kulissenstadt soll ausgerechnet einem Innovationscampus weichen. Gewinnt am Ende etwa doch die Zukunft?

programme.desc: When Johannes Bruckmeier jumps daringly over stairs and Geland with his skateboard, he regularly receives incredible looks. Because he is blind. Dadurch sterben bei ihm nach und nach die Zellen seiner Netzhaut ab. programme.desc: What to do if the bladder is not controllable? If a toilet always has to be in close? Leonie lives with an artificial bladder, Birgit with an irritant bladder with urge incontinence. "37 °: Must must - young and incontinent" will be available on Friday, September 5, 2025 from 8:00 a.m. on ZDF. / Was tun, wenn die Blase nicht kontrollierbar ist? Wenn eine Toilette immer in der Nahe sein muss? Inkontinenz gilt als Krankheit der Älteren - doch das stimmt nicht. September 2025 ab 8.00 Uhr in Web und App des ZDF zur Verfugung.

programme.desc: The baby's search continues and as Tonia tries to understand what happened to her child, the twin kidnappers, Florian and Tarzan, realizes that she has made one mistake behind the other. / Η αναζήτηση του μωρού συνεχίζεται και όσο η Τόνια προσπαθεί να καταλάβει τι συνέβη στο παιδί της, το δίδυμο των απαγωγέων, Φλοριάν και Ταρζάν, συνειδητοποιεί πως έχει κάνει το ένα λάθος πίσω από το άλλο.

programme.title: The time machine (e) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Manolis Rasoulis. The life and work of the multi -talented lyricist and writer Manolis Rasoulis comes to life through narratives and rare documents. From May 68, in the revenge of Gypsy and the supposedly. From Crete to India and the search for the hidden harmony of Guru Raznis. / Επεισόδιο: Μανώλης Ρασούλης. Η ζωή και το έργο του πολυτάλαντου στιχουργού και συγγραφέα Μανώλη Ρασούλη, ζωντανεύει μέσα από αφηγήσεις και σπάνια ντοκουμέντα. Από το γαλλικό Μάη του 68, στην Εκδίκηση της Γυφτιάς και τα Δήθεν. Από την Κρήτη στην Ινδία και την αναζήτηση της Κρυμμένης Αρμονίας του γκουρού Ραζνίς.

programme.title: We arrived! K3 E3 (E) / Φτάσαμε! Κ3 Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Milos. Seafood breeze, traditional flavors and music, as well as beautiful beaches await Jerom Kalouta in the new episode of the show, on the island with 75 beaches, picturesque fishing villages and volcanic soil. / Επεισόδιο: Μήλος. Θαλασσινό αεράκι, παραδοσιακές γεύσεις και μουσικές, αλλά και πανέμορφες ακρογιαλιές περιμένουν τον Ζερόμ Καλούτα στο νέο επεισόδιο της εκπομπής, στο νησί με τις 75 παραλίες, τα γραφικά ψαροχώρια και το ηφαιστειογενές έδαφος.

programme.title: Morning / Πρωίαν Σε Είδον

programme.title: The adventures of Hercules Poirot / Οι Περιπέτειες του Ηρακλή Πουαρό
programme.desc: Episode: Five little pigs. A beautiful girl, Lucy, asks Poirot to investigate the murder of her father, who was sentenced to death 14 years ago. Poirot agrees to look for the past, warning her that he may hear unpleasant truths. / Επεισόδιο: Πέντε Μικρά Γουρουνάκια. Μία όμορφη κοπέλα, η Λούσι, ζητάει από τον Πουαρό να ερευνήσει τη δολοφονία του πατέρα της, για την οποία είχε καταδικαστεί σε θάνατο η μητέρα της 14 χρόνια πριν. Ο Πουαρό δέχεται να ψάξει το παρελθόν, προειδοποιώντας την ότι ίσως ακούσει δυσάρεστες αλήθειες.

programme.title: Rosa of Smyrna / Η Ρόζα της Σμύρνης

Η αναζήτησή του θα τον οδηγήσει στη Ρόζα, μια γηραιά κυρία που ζει με την εγγονή της και κρατά το παρελθόν της κρυφό απ όλους. (105)

Πρωταγωνιστής του βίντεο ο παραπληγικός πρωταθλητής μας Αντώνης Δούρος που όλοι στο σπίτι υποδέχονται με μεγάλη εκτίμηση.

(130) / Εγκλωβισμένη σε μια πραγματικότητα που μοιάζει συμβατική, η Λιζ αποφασίζει να ξεκινήσει ένα ταξίδι στον κόσμο, σε μια προσπάθεια να βρει την εσωτερική ισορροπία και τον πραγματικό εαυτό της. Όσο κι αν η απόφασή του αυτή τον στενοχωρεί, δεν εξηγεί σε κανέναν γιατί.

Η σχέση της Δέσποινας και του Παντελή προχωράει. Με αργούς ρυθμούς, αλλά προχωράει. Σινεμά, θέατρο, φαγητό έξω και φυσικά κάθε πρωί φρέσκο πρωινό. Η Φούλη κι η Αριστέα πειράζουν την Δέσποινα πως πολύ το καθυστερεί ο Παντελής.

Η Κως αποτελεί έναν πολύ δημοφιλή προορισμό διακοπών, καθώς προσφέρει πολλές διαφορετικές επιλογές.

programme.title: We said good morning? / Καλημέρα Είπαμε;

programme.desc: George believes that in life you have to step on the corpses. So he leaves the family business and starts from scratch to prove the correctness of his theory. (119) / Ο Γιώργος πιστεύει ότι στη ζωή πρέπει να πατάς επί πτωμάτων. Έτσι, εγκαταλείπει την οικογενειακή επιχείρηση και ξεκινά από το μηδέν για να αποδείξει την ορθότητα της θεωρίας του. (119)

Ετοιμαστείτε για γέλιο, ανατροπές και πολύ κέφι.

programme.title: The adventures of Hercules Poirot K11 E1 (E) / Οι Περιπέτειες του Ηρακλή Πουαρό Κ11 Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Stigma on the face. A man, James Bendley, is condemned to the murder of a woman who was found dead in her home in the little village of Brunchini. Ένας άνδρας, ο Τζέιμς Μπέντλεϊ, καταδικάζεται για το φόνο μίας γυναίκας που βρέθηκε νεκρή στο σπίτι της, στο μικρό χωριουδάκι Μπρόουντχινι. Ο Επιθεωρητής Σπενς αμφιβάλλει για την ενοχή του Μπέντλεϊ και ο Ηρακλής Πουαρό καλείται να ερευνήσει περαιτέρω την υπόθεση.

Sean and the herd will do everything to never get the new glasses since, as long as he does not see, they do disorder. (Trans.) / Επεισόδιο: Τα νέα γυαλιά. Ο Αγρότης χρειάζεται επειγόντως νέα γυαλιά μιας και η όρασή του χειροτερεύει μέρα με την ημέρα. Ο Σον και το Κοπάδι θα κάνουν τα πάντα για να μην λάβει ποτέ τα νέα γυαλιά αφού, όσο δεν βλέπει, αυτά κάνουν αταξίες. (Μεταγλ.)

programme.title: Saine Police Officer E24 (E) / Αστυνόμος Σαΐνης Ε24 (Ε)
programme.desc: Police Officer Saine overcomes the obstacles and carries out his missions with the help of the intelligent niece of Penny and Bray's dog. / Ο Αστυνόμος Σαΐνης ξεπερνά τα εμπόδια και φέρνει εις πέρας τις αποστολές του με τη βοήθεια της ευφυούς ανιψιάς του Πένι και του σκύλου του Μπρέιν.

programme.title: Mr. Magu (E) / Ο Κύριος Μαγκού (Ε)
programme.desc: Mr. Magu is an eccentric millionaire with very poor eyesight who refuses to use glasses. So always happens to him. / O κος Μαγκού είναι ένας εκκεντρικός εκατομμυριούχος με πολύ κακή όραση που αρνείται να χρησιμοποιήσει γυαλιά. Επομένως πάντα κάτι του συμβαίνει.

programme.title: Zig and flesh (e) / Ζιγκ και Σάρκο (Ε)
programme.desc: French cartoon series. A constantly hungry hyena, a beautiful mermaid and a loyal and dedicated shark gets into a series of hilarious adventures. / Γαλλική σειρά κινουμένων σχεδίων. Μία ύαινα που διαρκώς πεινάει, μία όμορφη γοργόνα και ένας πιστός κι αφοσιωμένος καρχαρίας μπλέκουν σε μία σειρά από ξεκαρδιστικές περιπέτειες.

programme.title: Grandparents in Action E14 (E) / Παππούδες εν Δράσει Ε14 (Ε)
programme.desc: The food of the good Samaritan after the revelations of their stories feel calmer, they are more open to each other, they have become friends. Of course, Metaxas takes care to create problems in every way. At this difficult time, Paul proposes a solution. / Οι τρόφιμοι του Καλού Σαμαρείτη έπειτα από τις αποκαλύψεις των ιστοριών τους αισθάνονται πιο ήρεμοι, είναι πιο ανοιχτοί μεταξύ τους, έχουν γίνει φίλοι. Βέβαια η Μεταξά φροντίζει με κάθε τρόπο να τους δημιουργεί προβλήματα. Σ αυτή τη δύσκολη στιγμή ο Παύλος προτείνει μια λύση.

programme.title: Loxandra E5 (E) / Λωξάντρα Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Greek Social Series 1980. Loxandra lives in Constantinople in the mid -19th century. Orphaned by a child, she raised her younger siblings and in her thirties she marries a consul a larger widow, Dimitros. / Ελληνική κοινωνική σειρά παραγωγής 1980. Η Λωξάντρα ζει στην Κωνσταντινούπολη, στα μέσα του 19ου αιώνα. Ορφανή από παιδί, μεγάλωσε τα μικρότερα αδέλφια της και στα τριάντα της παντρεύεται με προξενιό ένα μεγαλύτερό της χήρο, τον Δημητρό.

programme.title: Backstage (E) / Παρασκήνιο (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Teacher and student in the theater. Greek production documentary series. A journey into the field of letters, art and culture of our country. / Επεισόδιο: Δάσκαλος και μαθητής στο θέατρο. Σειρά ντοκιμαντέρ ελληνικής παραγωγής. Ένα ταξίδι στο χώρο των γραμμάτων, της τέχνης και του πολιτισμού της χώρας μας.

programme.title: The road has its own story (e) / Ο Δρόμος Έχει τη Δική του Ιστορία (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Agia Marina Street. Agia Marina Street is located in Thissio under the National Observatory. The show visits this road on July 17, the day the church has dedicated to the celebration of St. Marina. / Επεισόδιο: Οδός Αγίας Μαρίνας. Η οδός Αγίας Μαρίνας βρίσκεται στο Θησείο κάτω από το Εθνικό Αστεροσκοπείο. Η εκπομπή επισκέπτεται τον συγκεκριμένο δρόμο στις 17 Ιουλίου, ημέρα που η Εκκλησία έχει αφιερώσει στον εορτασμό της Αγίας Μαρίνας.

programme.title: Discovering the world E15 (E) / Ανακαλύπτοντας τον Κόσμο Ε15 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: From the carriage to the car. Eliana and Ioanna visit the Greek Museum of Car. They learn about the history of the first cars, what their design was influenced and how their technology evolved to date. / Επεισόδιο: Από την άμαξα στο αυτοκίνητο. Η Ηλιάνα και η Ιωάννα επισκέπτονται το Ελληνικό Μουσείο Αυτοκινήτου. Μαθαίνουν για την ιστορία των πρώτων αυτοκινήτων, από τι επηρεάστηκε ο σχεδιασμός τους και πώς εξελίχθηκε η τεχνολογία τους μέχρι σήμερα.

programme.title: Welcome to K2 (E) Children / Καλώς τα Παιδιά Κ2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Finally, children are getting their own broadcast. Little viewers will see a quick, fun show with Tik Tok aesthetics, activities, meetings with scientists, writers and games and cultural events. / Επιτέλους, τα παιδιά αποκτούν τη δική τους εκπομπή. Οι μικροί τηλεθεατές θα δουν μια γρήγορη, διασκεδαστική εκπομπή με Tik Tok αισθητική, δραστηριότητες, συναντήσεις με επιστήμονες, συγγραφείς αλλά και παιχνίδια και πολιτιστικά δρώμενα.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Outside Map of K3 E4 (E) / Γκόρντον Ράμσεϊ: Εκτός Χάρτη Κ3 Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Midnight Sun in Finland. Gordon explores the dense forests, the crystal rivers and the muddy swamps of Lapia in northern Finland, gathering plenty of summer ingredients. / Επεισόδιο: Ο Ήλιος του Μεσονυχτίου στη Φινλανδία. Ο Gordon εξερευνά τα πυκνά δάση, τα κρυστάλλινα ποτάμια και τους λασπώδεις βάλτους της Λαπωνίας στη βόρεια Φινλανδία, μαζεύοντας άφθονα καλοκαιρινά υλικά.

programme.title: Those who took the mountains (e) / Αυτοί που Πήραν τα Βουνά (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Sulla and Elena. The Athenian - and anxious - Sulla, the place was not fitted! Elena, studying in Germany and a privately owned tutorial in downtown Thessaloniki, could no longer be able to breathe the Tsimiski exhaust. / Επεισόδιο: Ο Σύλλας και η Έλενα. Τον Αθηναίο - και ανήσυχο - Σύλλα, δεν τον χωρούσε ο τόπος! Η Έλενα, με σπουδές στη Γερμανία και ιδιόκτητο φροντιστήριο στο κέντρο της Θεσσαλονίκης, δεν άντεχε άλλο να αναπνέει το καυσαέριο της Τσιμισκή.

programme.title: My cheetah the plane tree K1 E62 (e) / Χαιρέτα μου τον Πλάτανο Κ1 Ε62 (Ε)
programme.desc: The Forestum is facing the fact that he will become a father. Everything inside him is overthrown and his despair of the impasse he sees in his relationship with Katerina grows. / Ο δασονόμος βρίσκεται αντιμέτωπος με το γεγονός ότι θα γίνει πατέρας. Τα πάντα μέσα του ανατρέπονται και η απελπισία του από το αδιέξοδο που διαβλέπει στη σχέση του με την Κατερίνα μεγαλώνει.

programme.title: My cheetah the plane tree K1 E63 (e) / Χαιρέτα μου τον Πλάτανο Κ1 Ε63 (Ε)
programme.desc: Katerina, after her meeting with Margarita at the Forestry Office, is frustrated and decides to forget Panagis. Kalliopi shares with Charalambis her suspicions that Elias is conspiring with Myrto. / Η Κατερίνα, μετά τη συνάντησή της με τη Μαργαρίτα στο Δασαρχείο, απογοητεύεται και αποφασίζει να ξεχάσει τον Παναγή. Η Καλλιόπη μοιράζεται με τον Χαραλάμπη τις υποψίες της πως ο Ηλίας συνωμοτεί με τη Μυρτώ.

programme.title: Mikis Theodorakis - Autobiography E5 (E) / Μίκης Θεοδωράκης - Αυτοβιογραφία Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: 1971-2000. Concerts where Earth, Spiritual Still, Junta Events, Cinema films, Canto General, Return to Greece 1974, Lenin Award, Music Thoughts, from 1983 to 1993, Fidel Castro. / Επεισόδιο: 1971-2000. Συναυλίες όπου γης, Πνευματικό Εμβατήριο, Εκδηλώσεις κατά της χούντας, Οι κινηματογραφικές ταινίες, Canto General, Επιστροφή στην Ελλάδα 1974, Βραβείο Λένιν, Σκέψεις για τη μουσική, Από το 1983 στο 1993, Ο Φιντέλ Κάστρο.

programme.title: The music of the world (e) / Οι Μουσικές του Κόσμου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: New Orleans. B part. The broadcast team is looking for this special something that New Orleans has, the spirit of its inhabitants, who has managed to give birth to a whole musical mythology that touched the whole planet. / Επεισόδιο: Νέα Ορλεάνη. Β Μέρος. Η ομάδα της εκπομπής αναζητά αυτό το ιδιαίτερο κάτι που διαθέτει η Νέα Ορλεάνη, το πνεύμα των κατοίκων της, που έχει καταφέρει να γεννήσει μια ολόκληρη μουσική μυθολογία που άγγιξε ολόκληρο τον πλανήτη.

programme.title: Maria Antoinette / Μαρία Αντουανέτα
programme.desc: The 14 -year -old naive and beautiful Maria Antoinette marries the French Prince Ludovico XVI and enters the full of scandals and conspiracies, a royal courtyard. He soon rebelled against the secluded palace and becomes the most iconic queen of France. (120) / Η 14χρονη αφελής και πανέμορφη Μαρία Αντουανέτα παντρεύεται τον Γάλλο πρίγκιπα Λουδοβίκο XVI και μπαίνει στη γεμάτη σκάνδαλα και συνωμοσίες, βασιλική αυλή. Σύντομα επαναστατεί ενάντια στο απομονωμένο παλάτι και γίνεται η πιο εμβληματική βασίλισσα της Γαλλίας. (120)

programme.title: Beckstrome Inspector K3 E1 (E) / Επιθεωρητής Μπέκστρομ Κ3 Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Beckstrom is traveling to Palma to investigate the unique murder case that has not been able to solve. Meanwhile, a Swedish is murdered in his hotel and Beccstrom begins his own research. / Ο Μπέκστρομ ταξιδεύει στην Πάλμα για να ερευνήσει τη μοναδική υπόθεση δολοφονίας που δεν έχει καταφέρει να εξιχνιάσει. Στο μεταξύ, ένας Σουηδός βρίσκεται δολοφονημένος στο ξενοδοχείο του κι ο Μπέκστρομ ξεκινά τη δική του έρευνα.

programme.desc: A triangle of hope for the Mediterranean cetaceans is located between Corsica, Nice and Genoa, an area protected by dangerous fishing practices, where dolphins and whales live. / Ένα τρίγωνο ελπίδας για τα κητοειδή της Μεσογείου βρίσκεται μεταξύ Κορσικής, Νίκαιας και Γένοβας, μια περιοχή που προστατεύεται από επικίνδυνες αλιευτικές πρακτικές, όπου ζουν δελφίνια και φάλαινες.

programme.title: Anzac Lemnos 1915 (E) / ANZAC Λήμνος 1915 (Ε)
programme.desc: This unique documentary explores a relatively unknown aspect of the story of Lemnos and the Anzac (Australian and New Zealand Army Corps) expeditionary body that participated in FP on the side of Antad's forces. / Το μοναδικό αυτό ντοκιμαντέρ εξερευνά μια σχετικά άγνωστη πτυχή της ιστορίας της Λήμνου και του εκστρατευτικού σώματος των ANZAC (Australian and New Zealand Army Corps) που συμμετείχε στον Α ΠΠ στο πλευρό των δυνάμεων της Αντάντ.

The Paris Room Orchestra and its music director, the famous German pianist and conductor Lars Vogt, celebrate an afternoon full of Mozart. / Συναυλία αφιερωμένη στον Μότσαρτ στους κήπους του ξενοδοχείου Sully, στο Παρίσι. Η Ορχήστρα Δωματίου του Παρισιού και ο μουσικός διευθυντής της, ο διάσημος Γερμανός πιανίστας και μαέστρος Lars Vogt, γιορτάζουν ένα απόγευμα γεμάτο Μότσαρτ.

programme.desc: Episode: Innovation and tradition in the Nestos plain. programme.title: Sunday in the village again (e) / Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kastaniani Konitsa. Brand new idea on traditional show. The village remains the protagonist, the people who inhabit it, their lives, the way they reproduce their traditions, everything they have achieved in time and everything they dream of. / Επεισόδιο: Καστάνιανη Κόνιτσας. Ολοκαίνουργια ιδέα πάνω στην παραδοσιακή εκπομπή. Πρωταγωνιστής παραμένει το χωριό, οι άνθρωποι που το κατοικούν, οι ζωές τους, ο τρόπος που αναπαράγουν τις παραδόσεις τους, όλα όσα έχουν πετύχει μέσα στο χρόνο κι όλα όσα ονειρεύονται.

programme.title: From the field to the shelf K2 E3 (E) / Από το Χωράφι στο Ράφι Κ2 Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Banana. We visited the settlement of Arvi on the southeast side of Crete, just opposite the coasts of North Africa, to find out about the cultivation of exotic fruit and how it manages and thrives in the area. / Επεισόδιο: Μπανάνα. Επισκεφτήκαμε τον οικισμό της Άρβης στη νοτιοανατολική πλευρά της Κρήτης, ακριβώς απέναντι από τις ακτές της Βορείου Αφρικής, για να μάθουμε για την καλλιέργεια του εξωτικού φρούτου και πώς τα καταφέρνει και ευδοκιμεί στην περιοχή.

programme.title: The Aegean of our life E3 / Το Αιγαίο της Ζωής μας Ε3
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: What was given and stayed. ERT3 records the course and work of the Aegean Group 130 volunteers, crossing the waves to provide meaningful care and hope to residents of the islands through medical, informative, construction, educational and cultural activities. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Ό,τι Δόθηκε και Έμεινε. Η ΕΡΤ3 καταγράφει την πορεία και το έργο των 130 εθελοντών της Ομάδας Αιγαίου, που διασχίζουν τα κύματα για να δώσουν ουσιαστική φροντίδα και ελπίδα στους κατοίκους των ακριτικών νησιών μέσα από ιατρικές, ενημερωτικές, κατασκευαστικές, εκπαιδευτικές και πολιτιστικές δράσεις.

programme.title: Greek events K8 E12 (E) / Ελλήνων Δρώμενα Κ8 Ε12 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kalymnos, land and sea. Kalymnos' great sponge history prevented its other side, the other, the other, where human activity preceded the seafood, establishing and creating its own map of local experiences. / Επεισόδιο: Κάλυμνος, Στεριά και Θάλασσα. Η μεγάλη σφουγγαράδικη ιστορία της Καλύμνου, εμπόδισε να γίνει γνωστή η άλλη όψη της, η στεριανή, όπου εκεί η ανθρώπινη δραστηριότητα προπορεύτηκε της θαλασσινής, θεμελιώνοντας και δημιουργώντας τον δικό της χάρτη των τοπικών βιωμάτων.

programme.title: Islands on the edge E1 (e) / Νησιά στην Άκρη Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Telendos. Telendos, a islet west of Kalymnos, eighteen miles from Turkey. Through the stories of its inhabitants we learn that, although life in Telendo is not easy, they are finally where they would like it to be. / Επεισόδιο: Τέλενδος. Τέλενδος, ένα νησάκι δυτικά της Καλύμνου, δεκαοκτώ μίλια από την Τουρκία. Μέσα από τις ιστορίες των κατοίκων της μαθαίνουμε πως, αν και η ζωή στην Τέλενδο δεν είναι εύκολη, τελικά βρίσκονται εκεί ακριβώς που θα ήθελαν να είναι.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Musikology E8 (E) / Musikology Ε8 (Ε)
programme.desc: We see that music affects children's artistic creation, we find the connection between Lana del Rey and Radiohead and we learn about Scotland's music. / Βλέπουμε πως η μουσική επηρεάζει την καλλιτεχνική δημιουργία των παιδιών, βρίσκουμε την σύνδεση ανάμεσα στην Lana Del Rey και τους Radiohead και μαθαίνουμε για την μουσική της Σκωτίας.

programme.title: Kingdoms of the Sun: The Poles / Reinos do Sol: Os Polos
programme.desc: The earth axis is inclined 23.5 degrees, and the heat of the sun does not incur evenly over its surface. The result is five major climate zones. The hottest are closer to the sun, the farthest, the poles, are the extreme opposite. Polar regions have the most disparate seasons and the most harsh living conditions. Even so, some of the most impressive and iconic species make this kingdom their home. Due to their unique relationship with the sun, the poles are actually exceptionally productive. Of the fearsome polar bears to lemish hyperactives, polar wildlife has adapted to prosper in these adverse conditions. And, more than any other kingdom, polar regions are essential for the rest of the planet to have conditions of life. There are many facets in the polar kingdoms of the sun. / O eixo da Terra está inclinado 23,5 graus, e o calor do Sol nao incide uniformemente sobre a sua superfície. O resultado sao cinco grandes zonas climáticas. As mais quentes estao mais perto do Sol, as mais afastadas, os polos, sao o oposto extremo. As regiões polares tem as estações do ano mais díspares e as condições de vida mais agrestes. Mesmo assim, algumas das especies mais impressionantes e iconicas fazem deste reino o seu lar. Devido à sua relaçao única com o Sol, os polos sao, na verdade, excecionalmente produtivos. Dos temíveis ursos polares aos hiperativos lemingues, a vida selvagem polar adaptou-se para prosperar nestas condições adversas. E, mais do que qualquer outro reino, as regiões polares sao essenciais para que o resto do planeta tenha condições de vida. Há muitas facetas nos reinos polares do Sol.

programme.title: Women's Volleyball: Women's Volleyball World Championship (semi-finals and final) (direct) / Voleibol Feminino: Campeonato do Mundo de Voleibol Feminino (Meias-Finais e Final) (Direto)
programme.desc: The Women's Volleyball Championship runs from August 22 to September 7 in Thailand. With a reformulated format and a record number of teams, the competition promises to be an unforgettable spectacle for the FAS from around the world. For the first time in history, 32 national teams, divided into eight groups of four, will fight for the world title. The competition, which is played every two years, will have its group stage games held in four host cities: Bangkok, Nakhon Ratchasima, Phuket and Chiang Mai. The elimination phase will be disputed entirely in banguecoque. This historical edition brings several news, such as the debut of Sweden and Slovakia in the competition, and the return of teams such as Egypt and France after feature films. programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: When the young Adelheid "Heidi" gets orfa, Aunt Detie takes her to live with her grandfather Alp, who lives isolated in the high alpine mountains. Initially reluctant to take care of Heidi, the grandfather quickly develops a deep affection for the granddaughter. Heidi adapts quickly to his new life, especially accompanying the young pastor of goats Peter. When Aunt Detie returns in the next summer to take her back to the city, Heidi does not want to go and her grandfather is not willing to give up her new "family". But the aunt is relentless, as he promised Heidi to a rich family to accompany his sick daughter, Clara, after school hours. Heidi and Clara approach, but after a few months, Heidi misses his grandfather and the high mountains. / Quando a jovem Adelheid "Heidi" fica orfa, a tia Detie leva-a para viver com o avô Alp, que vive isolado nas altas montanhas alpinas. Inicialmente relutante em cuidar de Heidi, o avô rapidamente desenvolve um profundo afeto pela neta. Heidi adapta-se rapidamente à sua nova vida, especialmente acompanhando o jovem pastor de cabras Peter. Quando a tia Detie regressa no verao seguinte para a levar de volta para a cidade, Heidi nao quer ir e o avô tambem nao está disposto a abdicar da sua nova "família". Mas a tia e implacável, pois prometeu Heidi a uma família rica para acompanhar a sua filha doente, Clara, apos o horário escolar. Heidi e Clara aproximam-se, mas passados alguns meses, Heidi sente saudades do avô e das altas montanhas.

programme.desc: The evocation of light in cinema, the masterpiece of Acácio de Almeida's work, one of the most important directors of photography of Portuguese cinematography, leads him to new reflections on his essence and his multiple manifestations. / A evocaçao da luz no cinema, materia-prima da obra de Acácio de Almeida, um dos mais importantes diretores de fotografia da cinematografia portuguesa, leva-o a novas reflexões sobre a sua essencia e as suas múltiplas manifestações.

programme.title: Mechanical orange, the mechanisms of violence / Laranja Mecânica, os Mecanismos da Violencia
programme.desc: In 1971, the British Anthony Burgess, author of the scandalous romance The Mechanical Orange, was criticized by all when Stanley Kubrick's movie was premiered. The public, the critics and some American judges were outraged. Under the spotlight and accused of inciting violence and murder, Burgess began writing a manuscript, which was never published and now exclusively revealed, in which he intended to explain once and for all the origins of this misunderstood work and reflect on the excessive violence in modern societies and the risks of equally violent institutional responses ... a true antidote to the danger of authoritarianism and the paranoia of security. Until his death in 1993, Anthony Burgess remained haunted by the misunderstanding that fell on his book. With the narrative thread of his unexpected appeal, discovered in 2019, and enlightening testimonies, including that of British writer Will Self, the documentary explores the multiple repercussions of a brilliant and visionary work, where humor attenuates the darkness, to show quao central and the question of free will. / Em 1971, o britânico Anthony Burgess, autor do escandaloso romance A Laranja Mecânica, foi criticado por todos quando o filme de Stanley Kubrick foi estreado. O público, os críticos e alguns juízes americanos ficaram indignados. Sob os holofotes e acusado de incitar a violencia e assassínio, Burgess começou a escrever um manuscrito, que nunca foi publicado e e agora revelado em exclusivo, no qual pretendia explicar de uma vez por todas as origens dessa obra incompreendida e refletir sobre os excessos de violencia nas sociedades modernas e os riscos de respostas institucionais igualmente violentas... Um verdadeiro antídoto para o perigo do autoritarismo e a paranoia da segurança. Ate à sua morte, em 1993, Anthony Burgess permaneceu assombrado pelo mal-entendido que se abateu sobre o seu livro. Com o fio narrativo do seu apelo inedito, descoberto em 2019, e testemunhos esclarecedores, incluindo o do escritor britânico Will Self, o documentário explora as múltiplas repercussões de uma obra brilhante e visionária, onde o humor atenua a escuridao, para mostrar quao central e a questao do livre arbítrio.

A fase de eliminaçao será disputada inteiramente em Banguecoque. Esta ediçao historica traz várias novidades, como a estreia da Suecia e da Eslováquia na competiçao, e o regresso de equipas como o Egipto e a França apos longas ausencias. A fase de grupos decorre ate 27 de Agosto, prometendo 48 jogos intensos que decidirao as 16 seleções que avançam para a fase de eliminaçao. programme.title: Olympique Lyonnais vs Olympique Marseille - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match / Olympique Lyonnais vs Olympique Marseille - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini match
programme.desc: Lyon and Marseille will face each other for the 126th time in all competitions, with OM becoming the second most often faced opponent by OL. It will be only their ninth meeting in August, the first since 2005. Lyon have lost five of their last six matches against Marseille in Ligue 1, only one defeat less than in the first 42 meetings between these two teams in the top-flight in the 21st century.

programme.title: Brighton and Hove Albion vs Manchester City - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Between 2017-18 and 2023-24, Brighton and Hove Albion only avoided defeat in two of 14 Premier League games against Man City ; last season, they didn’t lose against City, winning 2-1 at home and drawing 2-2 at the Etihad. Manchester City have won 19 out of 30 league matches against Brighton – among the 46 teams they’ve faced 25+ times, the only side they have a higher win ratio against is Swansea City.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Fulham - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Chelsea have lost just 8.3% of their Premier League games against Fulham, the joint-lowest loss rate one side has against another with a minimum of 20 meetings. Fulham won this exact fixture 2-1 last season, ending a 21-game winless streak away to Chelsea in all competitions. They’ve never won consecutive visits to Stamford Bridge in their history.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Burnley - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just one of their last 25 home games against Burnley in all competitions, going down 2-0 in January 2020. Of all teams to have visited Manchester United at least eight times in the Premier League, Burnley are one of three teams to have avoided defeat in more than half, along with Chelsea and Manchester City.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Arsenal - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 3 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Liverpool are winless in six Premier League matches against Arsenal, their longest winless run against the Gunners since going eight without a win between October 2007 and April 2011. The last three Premier League games between Liverpool and Arsenal at Anfield have all been drawn, while the Gunners are winless in their last 12 away games against the Reds since a 2-0 win back in September 2012, with manager Mikel Arteta starting for the Gunners that day.

programme.title: Kazakhstan vs Wales - UEFA European Qualifiers World Cup 2026 - MD5
programme.desc: The only previous meeting between Kazakhstan and Wales was earlier this year in March, with Wales winning 3-1 at the Cardiff City Stadium. Wales have won just two of their last 14 away matches, beating Latvia 2-0 in September 2023 and 2-1 against Montenegro in September 2024.

programme.desc: This will be just the second meeting between Vissel Kobe and Gwangju in the AFC Champions League Elite, after 2-0 win for Kobe in MD4 this season; Kobe lost their most recent encounter against South Korean sides, after winning two games, while Gwangju have lost only once in their three meetings with Japanese clubs in the competition, although it was against Kobe. programme.title: Shanghai Shenhua FC (CHN) vs Kawasaki Frontale (JPN) - AFC Champions League Elite 2024/25 - East R16
programme.desc: This is set to be the second meeting between Shanghai Shenhua and Kawasaki Frontale in the AFC CL Elite. Shenhua defeated Kawasaki Frontale 2-0 at home in the group stage this season. Kawasaki Frontale have won seven in the past nine encounters with Chinese opponents, having been winless in the previous six meetings. Shanghai Shenhua have scored in five consecutive home games in the AFC CL Elite, their joint-longest such streak in the competition.

programme.title: Race 1 - F1 Academy - F1 ACAD - Zandvoort Round
programme.desc: The opening 17-lap sprint of Round 5 is set to be a high-pressure contest where starts and first-corner battles may decide the order. programme.title: Race 2 - F1 Academy - F1 ACAD - Zandvoort Round

programme.title: Main Race - FIA Formula 1 World Championship - Dutch GP - 2025

programme.title: Practice 1 - F1 Pirelli Grand Prix Ditalia - 2025 - Italian GP / Practice 1 - F1 Pirelli Gran Premio DItalia - 2025 - Italian GP

programme.title: Qualifying- FIA Formula 3 Championship - Monza Round -2025
programme.desc: Tow management is everything in F3 qualifying. Teams coordinate runs to maximize straight-line gains, while drivers must nail chicane entries and exits to bank a clean lap. Timing, traffic and track evolution can swing the grid by tenths across a tightly packed field.

Sarezza Stumble Guys
programme.desc: The well-known author of the game about games, Sara Miljković, in the world of games known as Sarezza, is represented by Stumble Guys. In this game 32 players on the network race, jump and chase to the goal, until the best win the crown. / Poznata autorka videozapisa o igrama, Sara Miljković, u svetu igara poznata kao Sarezza, predstavlja nam Stumble Guys. U ovoj igri 32 igrača na mreži trkaju se, skaču i jure do cilja, sve dok najbolji ne osvoji krunu.

programme.title: Kidarena - Migzi Maus - Disney Epic Mickey
programme.desc: We try out a game that was published in 2010. years and inspired by the magical division world. The famous MIKA MAUS, but also the Osvald, a rabbit, which was the main hero of Disney films before the appearance of the legendary mouse. / Isprobavamo igricu koja je objavljena 2010. godine i inspirisana je čarobnim Diznijevim svetom. U igrici se pojavljuje čuveni Miki Maus, ali i Osvald, zec koji je bio glavni junak Diznijevih filmova pre pojave legendarnog miša.

programme.title: Caotutifruti is Astrobot 2 / Caotutifruti Je Astrobot 2
programme.desc: We try the popular game with the expert comments of our experienced host. Astro Bot was published in 2024. year and fifth is the continuation of the popular franchise in which the action and adventure are combined. / Isprobavamo popularnu igricu uz stručne komentare našeg iskusnog domaćina. Astro Bot je objavljen 2024. godine i peti je nastavak popularne franšize u kojoj se kombinuju akcija i avantura.

programme.title: Kidarena - Sarezza Roblox
programme.desc: The famous author of the game videos, Sara Miljković, in the world of games known as Sarezza, presents us Roblox. / Poznata autorka videozapisa o igrama, Sara Miljković, u svetu igara poznata kao Sarezza, predstavlja nam Roblox.

programme.title: Legendarni Tkdspale - Apex Legends
programme.desc: Tkdspale introduces us to the world of Apex Legends, in which we will find old heroes with new abilities in different domains. / Tkdspale uvodi nas u svet Apex Legends, u kome ćemo pronaći stare heroje sa novim sposobnostima u različitim domenima.

programme.title: Arkadne Legende - Cold Heart and Snake
programme.desc: Go with us on a trip to the past and remember some legendary arcade games! / Pođite sa nama na putovanje u prošlost i prisetite se nekih legendarnih arkadnih igara!

programme.title: Retro Migz1 - Nfs Most Wanted
programme.desc: We return to 2005. year and we recall the ninth part of the popular franchise Need for Speed. Over the years, this continuation has gained a cult status and a large number of fans. / Vraćamo se u 2005. godinu i prisećamo se devetog dela popularne franšize Need for Speed. Tokom godina, upravo ovaj nastavak je stekao kultni status i veliki broj fanova.

programme.title: Kidarena - Tasteless Rocket League
programme.desc: We take you to the world of hybrid football in which a player is operating a car that strives to control the ball greater than yourself. The goal of the game is, as in football, score. / Vodimo vas u svet hibridnog fudbala u kome igrač upravlja automobilom koji nastoji da kontroliše loptu veću od sebe. Cilj igre je, kao i u fudbalu, postići gol.

programme.title: Profesor Babic I Fortnite Ballistic

programme.title: Boks: David Benavidez - Oleksandr Gvozdyk
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: American Football - NFL: Philadelphia Eagles - Dallas Cowboys / Američki fudbal - NFL: Philadelphia Eagles - Dallas Cowboys
programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The league performs 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Red Star Meridianbet - Spartak Office Shoes, G1 / Košarka - KLS: Crvena zvezda Meridianbet - Spartak Office Shoes, G1
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

Trenutno broji 19 ekipa u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Najviše osvojenih titula broji rukometni klub Kil. programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA Liga: Dubai - Crvena Zvezda / Košarka - ABA liga: Dubai - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.desc: "Anyway, we have to play in Rudolfinum once. There is always a well -tuned piano, and then, that's the main one, go there nice people," says Jiří Šlitr in the intermediate of the song "Three Aunts". The festival of the autumn of the autumn fulfilled Šlitr's wishes on the occasion of 50 years since his death by a project, whose center is the second half of the famous couple, living classic Jiří Suchý / "Stejně, musíme si jednou zahrát v Rudolfinu. Tam bejvá vždycky slušně naladěný piáno, a potom, to je to hlavní, tam choděj fajnový lidi," říká v mezihře písně "Tři tety" Jiří Šlitr. Festival Struny podzimu splnil Šlitrovo přání při příležitosti 50 let od jeho úmrtí projektem, jehož středobodem je druhá polovina slavne dvojice, žijící klasik Jiří Suchý

programme.title: I'm not yet who I want to be / Ještě nejsem, kým chci být
programme.desc: A unique documentary about photographer Libuš Jarcovjákov, who exposes her life journey and consists only of her photographs and diary notes. Snímek byl oceněn Českým lvem a Cenou česke filmove kritiky a ČFTA byl vybrán jako kandidát na Oscara v kategorii nejlepší mezinárodní film (skryte titulky)

programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): HSV - St. Pauli, Bundesliga 2025/2026, Hamburg / Nogomet (M): HSV - St. Pauli, Bundesliga 2025/2026 , Hamburg
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Serija prinaša redke posnetke iz arhivov studia Disney, prizore iz nekaterih njegovih najslavnejših filmo
programme.desc: Part 4: On July 17, 1955, the Disneyland door opened, it was flooded by visitors. Almost half of America has watched the direct television broadcast of events. Disneyland attracted a million visitors in the first ten weeks, followed by five million a year. Walt's creation had to be seen. By 1960, Disney was at the top of one of the most profitable entertainment companies in the world. The constant flow of Disneyland's revenue meant that for the first time in his 40-year career, he got rid of the influence of banks. But he was refining his amusement park or controlling television shows and half a dozen films made every year by his studio, he seemed to be more interested in his legacy than taking artistic risks that made him famous. Mary Poppins, who made his debut in the summer of 1964, is based on one of his favorite children's books. Disney's most thoughtful processing of the story of his hard -hearted father is Disney's film. The film became a big hit and was nominated for 13 Oscars, which brought Disney the first and only nomination for the best film. In 1965, news echoed that Walt Disney was planning another major project in central Florida: an experimental prototype community of the future or EPCOT. It did not wait for its occurrence, as it died on 14 December 1966 at the age of 65 from lung cancer. He has built a media and entertainment company that still stands today, got more Oscars than anyone in history, created cinematic art and invented a new type of American holiday goal. His death was the news on the covers all over the world.Walt Disney / USA / 2015 / Director: Sarah Colt. / 4. del: Ko so se 17. julija 1955 odprla vrata Disneylanda, so ga preplavili obiskovalci. Skoraj polovica Amerike je gledala neposreden televizijski prenos dogodkov. Disneyland je v prvih desetih tednih pritegnil milijon obiskovalcev, nato pa jih je prihajalo po pet milijonov na leto. Waltovo stvaritev je bilo treba videti. Do leta 1960 je bil Disney na vrhu enega najbolj dobičkonosnih zabavnih podjetij na svetu. Stalen tok prihodkov iz Disneylanda je pomenil, da se je prvič v svoji 40-letni karieri znebil vpliva bank. Toda naj je izpopolnjeval svoj zabaviščni park ali nadziral televizijske oddaje in pol ducata filmov, ki jih je vsako leto posnel njegov studio, se je zdelo, da ga bolj zanima njegova zapuščina kot prevzemanje umetniških tveganj, zaradi katerih je postal slaven. Mary Poppins, ki je debitirala poleti 1964, temelji na eni izmed njegovih najljubših otroških knjig. Film o disfunkcionalni družini je Disneyjeva najbolj premišljena predelava zgodbe o njegovem trdosrčnem očetu. Film je postal velika uspešnica in je bil nominiran za 13 oskarjev, kar je Disneyju prineslo prvo in edino nominacijo za najboljši film. Leta 1965 je odjeknila novica, da Walt Disney načrtuje še en velik projekt v osrednji Floridi: Eksperimentalno prototipno skupnost prihodnosti ali Epcot. Njenega nastanka ni dočakal, saj je 14. decembra 1966 v starosti 65 let umrl zaradi raka na pljučih. Zgradil je medijsko in razvedrilno podjetje, ki stoji še danes, dobil je več oskarjev kot kdorkoli v zgodovini, ustvaril kinematografsko umetnost in izumil novo vrsto ameriškega počitniškega cilja. Njegova smrt je bil novica na naslovnicah po vsem svetu.WALT DISNEY / ZDA / 2015 / Režija: Sarah Colt.

Zahtevajo povezovanje znanja, vključujejo vsebine, ki jih ni v šolskih programih, in zahtevajo raziskovalno miselnost.Slovenski dijaki so na teh tekmovanjih zelo uspešni. programme.desc: R: Švigelj Tomaž ... RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra is presented with an interesting, jazz -colored program. The Suite for the Dmitry Shostakovich Promenade Orchestra and the popular Rapsody in blue George Gershwin will be scheduled. The soloist will be pianist Lisa Smirna, an Austrian musician of Russian roots. She studied music in her hometown of Moscow, and in the 1990s she studied in Salzburg and then settled in Austria permanently. After a great appearance at the famous Carnegie Hall in New York and at the Salzburg Festival, she is today a guest of all the world's stage. The conductor will be Darko Butorac, who is now considered one of the most sought after young conductors. / R: Švigelj Tomaž... Simfonični orkester RTV Slovenija se predstavlja z zanimivim, džezovsko obarvanim programom. Na sporedu bosta Suita za promenadni orkester Dmitrija Šostakoviča in priljubljena Rapsodija v modrem Georgea Gershwina. Solistka bo pianistka Lisa Smirna, avstrijska glasbenica ruskih korenin. Glasbo je študirala v svojem rojstnem mestu Moskvi, v devetdesetih letih prejšnjega stoletja pa se je izpopolnjevala v Salzburgu in se potem za stalno naselila v Avstriji. Po odličnem nastopu v sloviti Carnegiejevi dvorani v New Yorku in na Salzburškem festivalu je danes gostja vseh svetovnih koncertnih odrov. Dirigent bo Darko Butorac, ki dandanes velja za enega najbolj iskanih mladih dirigentov.

programme.title: Memories: prof. dr. Niko Tosh, 1. Part, Mon. / Spomini: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 1. del, pon.
programme.desc: Lawyer and sociologist prof. dr. Nika Tosh is known by many generations of students of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and is known to the general public as the founder and head of the Center for Research of Public Opinion and Mass Communications. The first two of the four parts of the show are, through his memories and the memories of his ancestors, interesting Chronicle of Life in Slovenia in the last century on his life path from Maribor through Celje to Ljubljana, among personalities whose stories (even with valuable documentary recordings) are involved in the narrative, and are also the colonel of the royal army Draz Mihailov, Wife, sculptor Karl Bulovcev, uncle and aunt Nika Tosh, the Mrak family, from which Tosh's mother, painter and Olympian Toso Primožič and many others come from. The third and fourth parts of the memories of Nika Tosh are dedicated to the development of Slovenian and Yugoslav society through the findings of public opinion polls, and again the entire Gallery of Slovenian, Yugoslav and European figures in this field is involved in the narrative. Today, the eighty -year -old annual professor Niko Toš is an outstanding storyteller and a weighty thoughtful about society and time we live, so it is definitely worth listening to. / Pravnika in sociologa prof. dr. Nika Toša poznajo mnoge generacije študentov Fakultete za družbene vede, širša javnost pa ga pozna kot ustanovitelja in predstojnika Centra za raziskovanje javnega mnenja in množičnih komunikacij. Prva dva od štirih delov oddaje sta skozi njegove spomine ter spomine njegovih prednikov zanimiva kronika življenja na Slovenskem v zadnjem stoletju na njegovi življenjski poti od Maribora prek Celja v Ljubljano, med osebnostmi, katerih zgodbe se (tudi z dragocenimi dokumentarnimi posnetki) vpletajo v pripoved, pa so tudi polkovnik kraljeve vojske Draža Mihailovič, major Mirko Bitenc, pisatelj in dramatik Ivan Mrak in njegova žena, kiparka Karla Bulovčeva, stric in teta Nika Toša, družina Mrak, iz katere izhaja Toševa mama, slikar in olimpijec Tošo Primožič in mnogi drugi. Tretji in četrti del Spominov Nika Toša sta posvečena razvoju slovenske in jugoslovanske družbe skozi izsledke raziskav javnega mnenja in spet se v pripoved vpleta cela galerija slovenskih, jugoslovanskih in evropskih osebnosti s tega področja. Danes oseminosemdesetletni letni profesor Niko Toš je izjemen pripovednik in tehten premišljevalec o družbi in času, ki ga živimo, zato mu je vsekakor vredno prisluhniti.

programme.title: Worldwide: Marky Ramone - penultimate Ramona, Mon. / Svetovno: Marky Ramone – predzadnji Ramone, pon.
programme.desc: When Marc Steven Bell was invited to the Ramones Brotherhood in 1978, his artistic biography already stated that it belongs to "an empty generation." This is how Marky Ramone appeared and, on the album Road to Ruin, for half a year later, proved that he quickly won all the "1-2-3-4" elements. He overwhelmed for 15 years in the band and recorded 8 studio albums, and today, with his band Blitzkrieg, evokes memories of a band that was inspired by everyone, but no one knew how to imitate it. / Ko je bil Marc Steven Bell leta 1978 povabljen v bratovščino Ramones, je v njegovem umetniškem življenjepisu že pisalo, da pripada »prazni generaciji.« Prehod med dvema setoma bobnov zanj ni bil težak, le v skladu s pravili bratovščine si je moral izbrati novo ime. Tako se je pojavil Marky Ramone in na albumu Road to Ruin že dobrega pol leta kasneje dokazal, da je hitro osvojil vse »1-2-3-4« prvine. V skupini je previharil 15 let ter z njo posnel 8 studijskih albumov, danes pa s svojo skupino Blitzkrieg obuja spomine na skupino, po kateri so se zgledovali vsi, nihče pa je ni znal posnemati.

programme.sub-title: The documentary Living Mountain is the story of top mountaineer Irena Mrak, her attachment to her hometown, to her home rock, her friendship with a co -star and a partner and a relationship with life values. / Dokumentarni film Živeti gore je zgodba o vrhunski alpinistki Ireni Mrak, njeni navezanosti na domači kraj, na domačo skalo, o njenem prijateljstvu s soplezalko in partnerjem soplezalcem ter odnosu do življenjskih vrednot.
programme.desc: The documentary is designed as a tribute to the human spirit and the desire to change with the power of one's own will. programme.title: Manchester By The Sea
programme.desc: Lee Chandler is a silent single ganger who works as a craftsman for a apartment block in Boston. On a cold winter day, he receives a call to change his life in one fell swoop. His brother Joe died of heart failure. Now Lee is supposed to take responsibility for his 16-year-old nephew Patrick. He reluctantly returns to his homeland, the port city of Manchester-by-the-Sea, and doubts whether he was a teenager-to draw a great deal of the challenge. Once at home, he is not only confronted with the life of the local people, but also with his own past. / Lee Chandler ist ein schweigsamer Einzelganger, der als Handwerker eines Wohnblocks in Boston arbeitet. An einem kalten Wintertag erhalt er einen Anruf, der sein Leben auf einen Schlag verandert. Sein Bruders Joe ist an Herzversagen gestorben. Nun soll Lee die Verantwortung fur seinen 16-jahrigen Neffen Patrick ubernehmen. Äusserst widerwillig kehrt er in seine Heimat, die Hafenstadt Manchester-by-the-Sea, zuruck und zweifelt, ob er der Herausforderung - einen Teenager gross zu ziehen - uberhaupt gewachsen ist.
